# google_iam_workload_identity_pool_provider

Get information about a Cloud IAM WorkloadIdentityPoolProvider.



## Example Usage

```hcl
data "google_iam_workload_identity_pool_provider" "default" {
  workload_identity_pool_id = google_iam_workload_identity_pool_provider.example.workload_identity_pool_id
  workload_identity_pool_provider_id = google_iam_workload_identity_pool_provider.example.workload_identity_pool_provider_id
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:



* `workload_identity_pool_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID used for the pool, which is the final component of the pool resource name. This
  value should be 4-32 characters, and may contain the characters [a-z0-9-]. The prefix
  `gcp-` is reserved for use by Google, and may not be specified.

* `workload_identity_pool_provider_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID for the provider, which becomes the final component of the resource name. This
  value must be 4-32 characters, and may contain the characters [a-z0-9-]. The prefix
  `gcp-` is reserved for use by Google, and may not be specified.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
